details: Rode 24.2 mi at avg HR 157 (tempo). Harder than planned; that's why Tuesday was rest.
Edgewood: 18.3 mi at avg HR 137. Right on target.
4–5 mi easy warm-up, 3 × Full Hascall Hill at 8/10 effort, 4–5 min easy between, easy spin home. Stop if a rep is 15+ s slower than the first. Rode 5 reps (Hascall Climb x5).
Optional 30–45 min spin, or off. Keep it easy so your legs are fresh for Sunday's long ride.

40–50 mi on the Silver Comet, about 3–3.5 hours. Steady Zone 2 the whole way; ease off on the climbs to stay under the cap. Eat every 30–45 min and drink about a bottle an hour. Threshold 3 × 10 min moves to Tue Nov 3.
